title: A stream DMA engine, block by block
summary: Eight modules: a CSR block and an FSM in control; read port, FIFO, byte packer and write port on the data path.

quote.exact:
module dma_top #(
  parameter int AW         = 32,
  parameter int DW         = 64,
  parameter int LW         = 20,
  parameter int MAX_BURST  = 16,
  parameter int FIFO_DEPTH = 32,
  parameter int NB         = DW / 8,
  parameter int BW         = LW - 2,
  parameter int BLW        = $clog2(MAX_BURST) + 1
) (
  input  logic           clk,
  input  logic           rst_n,
  // register bus
  input  logic           csr_we,
  input  logic [4:2]     csr_addr,
  input  logic [31:0]    csr_wdata,
  output logic [31:0]    csr_rdata,
  output logic           irq,
  // read request / response
  output logic           rd_req_valid,
  input  logic           rd_req_ready,
  output logic [AW-1:0]  rd_req_addr,
  output logic [BLW-1:0] rd_req_len,
  input  logic           rd_rsp_valid,
  output logic           rd_rsp_ready,
  input  logic [DW-1:0]  rd_rsp_data,
  input  logic           rd_rsp_err,
  // write request / data / response
  output logic           wr_req_valid,
  input  logic           wr_req_ready,
  output logic [AW-1:0]  wr_req_addr,
  output logic [BLW-1:0] wr_req_len,
  output logic           wr_dat_valid,
  input  logic           wr_dat_ready,
  output logic [DW-1:0]  wr_dat_data,
  output logic [NB-1:0]  wr_dat_strb,
  output logic           wr_dat_last,
  input  logic           wr_rsp_valid,
  input  logic           wr_rsp_err,
  // debug: FIFO occupancy
  output logic [$clog2(FIFO_DEPTH):0] fifo_level
);

module dma_csr #(
  parameter int AW = 32,
  parameter int LW = 20
) (
  input  logic          clk,
  input  logic          rst_n,
  // register bus (word addressed)
  input  logic          csr_we,
  input  logic [4:2]    csr_addr,
  input  logic [31:0]   csr_wdata,
  output logic [31:0]   csr_rdata,
  // configuration to the engine
  output logic          start,
  output logic [AW-1:0] src_base,
  output logic [AW-1:0] dst_base,
  output logic [LW-1:0] len,
  // status from the engine
  input  logic          busy,
  input  logic          done_set,
  input  logic          err_set,
  input  logic [1:0]    err_code,
  output logic          irq
);
quote.suffix:
localparam logic [2:0] A_CTRL = 3'd0, A_STATUS = 3'd1, A_SRC = 3'd2,
                         A_DST  = 3'd3, A_LEN    = 3'd4, A_ERR = 3'd5;

quote.exact:
module dma_ctrl #(
  parameter int BW  = 18,  // beat-count width
  parameter int BLW = 5    // burst-length width
) (
  input  logic           clk,
  input  logic           rst_n,
  // from / to the CSRs
  input  logic           start,
  input  logic           len_zero,
  input  logic [2:0]     src_off,
  input  logic [2:0]     dst_off,
  output logic           busy,
  output logic           drain,          // ERROR: drain the FIFO, finish bursts with empty strobes
  output logic           done_set,
  output logic           err_set,
  output logic [1:0]     err_code,
  // datapath enable: latch the configuration
  output logic           load,
  // read side
  input  logic           rd_has_burst,
  output logic           rd_start,      // also acknowledges the read address generator
  input  logic           rd_busy,
  input  logic           rd_done,
  input  logic           rd_err,
  input  logic           fifo_push,     // a read beat entered the FIFO
  input  logic           fifo_almost_full,
  // write side
  input  logic           wr_has_burst,
  input  logic [BLW-1:0] wr_burst_len,
  output logic           wr_start,      // also acknowledges the write address generator
  input  logic           wr_busy,
  input  logic           wr_done,
  input  logic           wr_err
);

quote.exact:
module dma_addr_gen #(
  parameter int AW        = 32,
  parameter int LW        = 20,             // transfer length width (bytes)
  parameter int MAX_BURST = 16,             // beats
  parameter int BW        = LW - 2,         // beat-count width
  parameter int BLW       = $clog2(MAX_BURST) + 1
) (
  input  logic           clk,
  input  logic           rst_n,
  // control
  input  logic           load,         // latch base and length (dma_ctrl, LOAD)
  input  logic [AW-1:0]  base,         // byte address, any alignment
  input  logic [LW-1:0]  len,          // bytes
  input  logic           burst_ack,    // the port took the current burst
  output logic           has_burst,    // bursts remain
  // the current burst
  output logic [AW-1:0]  burst_addr,   // beat aligned
  output logic [BLW-1:0] burst_len,    // beats, 1..MAX_BURST
  output logic [BW-1:0]  total_beats   // beats the whole transfer touches
);
quote.suffix:
// ---- datapath registers: where the next burst starts, how many beats remain
  logic [AW-1:0] addr_q;

quote.exact:
module dma_rd_port #(
  parameter int AW  = 32,
  parameter int DW  = 64,
  parameter int BLW = 5
) (
  input  logic           clk,
  input  logic           rst_n,
  // control (dma_ctrl)
  input  logic           start,
  input  logic [AW-1:0]  addr,
  input  logic [BLW-1:0] len,
  output logic           busy,      // a burst is in flight
  output logic           done,      // pulse with the burst's last beat
  output logic           err,       // valid with done: some beat had an error
  // read request channel
  output logic           rd_req_valid,
  input  logic           rd_req_ready,
  output logic [AW-1:0]  rd_req_addr,
  output logic [BLW-1:0] rd_req_len,
  // read response channel
  input  logic           rd_rsp_valid,
  output logic           rd_rsp_ready,
  input  logic [DW-1:0]  rd_rsp_data,
  input  logic           rd_rsp_err,
  // to the FIFO
  output logic           fifo_push,
  output logic [DW-1:0]  fifo_wdata,
  input  logic           fifo_full
);
quote.prefix: // response beats into the FIFO. It stops accepting beats while the FIFO is full.
quote.suffix:
logic           req_q;      // request waiting for rd_req_ready
  logic [AW-1:0]  addr_q;

quote.exact:
module dma_fifo #(
  parameter int DW       = 64,
  parameter int DEPTH    = 32,
  parameter int AF_LEVEL = 16,   // almost_full once more than this many entries are held
  parameter int PW       = $clog2(DEPTH)
) (
  input  logic          clk,
  input  logic          rst_n,
  input  logic          clear,     // empty it (a new transfer starts)
  // write side
  input  logic          push,
  input  logic [DW-1:0] wdata,
  output logic          full,
  output logic          almost_full,
  // read side
  input  logic          pop,
  output logic [DW-1:0] rdata,
  output logic          empty,
  output logic [PW:0]   level
);
quote.prefix:
// almost_full tells dma_ctrl there's no room for another full burst, which is how backpressure
// from the write side reaches the read side.
quote.suffix:
// ---- datapath: storage and the two pointers
  logic [DW-1:0] mem [DEPTH];

quote.exact:
module dma_packer #(
  parameter int DW = 64,
  parameter int BW = 18,          // beat-count width
  parameter int NB = DW / 8,      // byte lanes
  parameter int OW = $clog2(NB)   // lane-offset width
) (
  input  logic          clk,
  input  logic          rst_n,
  // control
  input  logic          load,
  input  logic          drain,
  input  logic [OW-1:0] src_off,
  input  logic [OW-1:0] dst_off,
  input  logic [OW-1:0] len_lo,     // length mod NB
  input  logic [BW-1:0] in_beats,   // beats the source touches
  input  logic [BW-1:0] out_beats,  // beats the destination touches
  // from the FIFO
  input  logic          in_valid,
  output logic          in_ready,
  input  logic [DW-1:0] in_data,
  // to the write port
  output logic          out_valid,
  input  logic          out_ready,
  output logic [DW-1:0] out_data,
  output logic [NB-1:0] out_strb
);
quote.prefix:
// On drain (after an error) it empties the FIFO and offers empty-strobe beats, so a write
// burst already on the bus can finish.

quote.exact:
module dma_wr_port #(
  parameter int AW  = 32,
  parameter int DW  = 64,
  parameter int BLW = 5,
  parameter int NB  = DW / 8
) (
  input  logic           clk,
  input  logic           rst_n,
  // control (dma_ctrl)
  input  logic           start,
  input  logic [AW-1:0]  addr,
  input  logic [BLW-1:0] len,
  output logic           busy,     // a burst is in flight: don't start another
  output logic           done,     // pulse with the write response
  output logic           err,      // valid with done
  // from the packer
  input  logic           pk_valid,
  output logic           pk_ready,
  input  logic [DW-1:0]  pk_data,
  input  logic [NB-1:0]  pk_strb,
  // write request channel
  output logic           wr_req_valid,
  input  logic           wr_req_ready,
  output logic [AW-1:0]  wr_req_addr,
  output logic [BLW-1:0] wr_req_len,
  // write data channel
  output logic           wr_dat_valid,
  input  logic           wr_dat_ready,
  output logic [DW-1:0]  wr_dat_data,
  output logic [NB-1:0]  wr_dat_strb,
  output logic           wr_dat_last,
  // write response channel
  input  logic           wr_rsp_valid,
  input  logic           wr_rsp_err
);
quote.prefix:
// data channel (the bus may stall it with wr_dat_ready), marks the burst's last beat, and
// waits for the write response.
quote.suffix:
logic           req_q;     // request waiting for wr_req_ready
  logic           rsp_q;     // last beat sent, waiting for the response
